caption: Scheduling a post first asks you to connect a social profile or integration. Without one you can only store ideas.
The New idea editor shows the character limit per network, such as 280 for X and 2,200 for Instagram. Ideas need no connected profile. The staff photos at the bottom right are hidden.
Our test idea saved with two lines, accents and hashtags intact. It shows as Not posted yet on the Ideas wall.
The Ideas menu offers Shared links, New collection and Bulk create ideas. We found no export in this menu, though we did not test every route.
The subscription shortcut opened a live Stripe checkout for Advanced, billed yearly with 30 profiles: EUR 1,770.54, with no VAT line shown. We paid nothing. The account e-mail is hidden.
